title: Sitemap Completion — Certification
known_risk: package.json's 'generate:sitemap' script (scripts/generate-sitemap.js) walks the entire filesystem and OVERWRITES root sitemap.xml with an incompatible flat <urlset> format (one entry per literal .html file, including dist/ duplicates). It predates this milestone's <sitemapindex> architecture and was not touched (out of scope to modify/remove unrelated legacy tooling), but running it would destroy the deterministic sitemapindex this phase built. Flagged for a future cleanup phase, not fixed here.
methodology: Every <loc> in the live root sitemap.xml was extracted and cross-checked against the 34 sitemap files that exist on disk, against the 10 published-domain prefixes, and against cheese's correct absence. site-pages.xml was checked directly for the 10 domain-hub URLs plus /ingredients/. The generator was run twice consecutively and the output diffed (ignoring timestamps) to confirm determinism.
